# Local Pose Confidence Patch

`vision_pose_bundle.mjs` is generated by `node scripts/build_pose_confidence_bundle.mjs`
from the preserved `vision_bundle.mjs`. Only the two PoseLandmarker result
converters are changed; face and hand conversion and all inference code stay intact.
The camera face tracker continues to import the original bundle.

The old converters discard visibility and presence, allowing occluded joints to
pass the application's confidence gates. The patch reads protobuf fields 4 and 5
using the bundled protobuf parser. Missing visibility is rejected; presence stays
optional because world landmarks can omit it.

References: [MediaPipe landmark schema](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/blob/master/mediapipe/framework/formats/landmark.proto)
and [upstream landmark converter](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/blob/master/mediapipe/tasks/web/components/processors/landmark_result.ts).
The patch is deliberately scoped instead of replacing the installed runtime/WASM.
